clips.title: The story
paras: In Blackfathom Deeps, cultists hold shards of Soran'ruk, a shattered prison orb. The pieces still carry fel energy from the demon once bound inside.

Soran'ruk's prison orb was broken apart after the demon fell from favor with the Burning Legion. Demons who displease their masters may have their spirits sealed in orbs, then given to fel spellcasters as sources of power. The Twilight's Hammer cultists in the submerged ruins of Blackfathom Deeps possess smaller shards from one half of the orb. They draw on the lingering demonic essence for their own workings.
